selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection found a live contract mismatch: federated proposal normalization preserves up to 16 validation_commands, while runAcceptance silently sliced the executable evidence set to 8. Therefore a proposal with nine meaningful validations could pass after only the first eight ran; a failing ninth command was silently erased from the acceptance decision.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: The committed four-mode router hits its singular evidence-rich central bottleneck gate (centrality >= 0.85 and evidence density >= 0.70), selecting DEEP_DEVELOPMENT without forced mode rotation.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. Selection/routing use committed DWAC source-contract replay over fresh canonical main while the provider remained transiently unavailable.

pre_fix_reproduction.input: Nine explicit validation commands: the first eight return success and the ninth is a failing command.
pre_fix_reproduction.observed: Current main returned passed=true / hardGate=PASS with exactly eight commands and eight results; the ninth validation was silently omitted by slice(0,8).

changes: runAcceptance now observes at most one command beyond the eight-command execution budget before any validation command is executed.
If more than eight non-empty explicit validation commands are present, acceptance fails closed with VALIDATION_COMMAND_BUDGET_EXCEEDED instead of silently truncating evidence.
The failure receipt remains bounded: it exposes the first eight commands plus validationBudget {limit:8, observedAtLeast:9}, and executes zero commands so there is no partial-validation ambiguity.
inferValidationCommands continues to use the existing eight-command bound; its currently known heuristics remain below that bound.

validation.validation_note: Focused local module harness reconstructed the branch acceptance code and isolated the budget gate with a compatible runCommand stub; the overflow path returns before command execution. The branch blobs were then fetched back from GitHub and matched the locally validated source/test content.

truth_boundaries: This closes silent truncation for explicit validation sets larger than the current execution budget; it does not choose which evidence should run when more than eight validations are genuinely required.
Repository-wide or monorepo validation discovery remains incomplete; fail-closed overflow intentionally surfaces that policy gap instead of claiming exhaustive validation.
This is not an OS-level filesystem/network sandbox; validation workspace confinement remains unresolved.
Equivalent Windows descendant-process containment remains unresolved.
Arbitrary complex repository semantic synthesis remains UNRESOLVED.
Filesystem crash-level atomicity for arbitrary I/O/process failure remains unresolved.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action was performed.
